title: xpute machine
description: A program's machine, or one of its protocols: the memory, stack, rings and GPU its guest asks for (machine.json), or the commands one protocol carries (a protocol file). xpute-gen writes from them both ends' code: MACHINE, a stub per `export` command and a handler per `import` command on the host, and on the guest MACHINE, a function per `import` command and a trait for the `export` commands. xpute's own protocols (spec/abi/cmd.json, spec/abi/fs.json) are protocol files too.

gen.description: Where a file's code goes, each from this file's directory: its TypeScript (a protocol's enums in a folder named as it is, beside it) and its Rust (a machine's constants, which the guest's build script also includes as it links).

mem.description: The memory the host gives the guest, which never grows.

bytes.description: The sizes a host may give, any one of them, each a whole number of regions. The program picks one; the module is linked against the smallest.

region_bytes.description: What a reservation is counted in.

min_heap_bytes.description: The heap the smallest size must leave past the front, the linker's data and the program's fixed ranges, checked as the guest compiles.

module_bytes.description: A module's stack, first in the memory.

thread_bytes.description: A native guest's thread's stack, outside the memory.

slot_bytes.description: A packet's room, a power of two and a multiple of 8.

sq_cap.description: Frames the submission ring holds, a power of two.

cq_cap.description: Frames the completion ring holds, a power of two, more than sq_cap + turn_posts.

turn_posts.description: What one turn posts besides its replies: its events, its hostcalls, and a call's slot.

fs.description: The file device the guest asks for (spec/abi/fs.json), which the host attaches and backs with the program's storage. Absent, none, and a file command is refused ENODEV.

gpu.description: The GPU the guest asks for: a stream past the rings the guest writes its GPU calls into and the host runs after each turn (xpute-gpu), which says its own head (xpute-guest ipc/stream.rs). Absent, none.

features.description: WebGPU's feature names. The surface's format is the platform's, and the limits the adapter's.

optional.description: What it takes where the adapter has it.

name.description: A protocol's word for itself, for the generated names only.

export.description: What the guest implements and the host calls: what the host sends the guest.

import.description: What the host implements and the guest calls: what the guest posts to the host.

extern.description: Types the program's Rust names, read and written as a number.

name.description: Any but Command, which xpute makes from out and in.

unknown.description: The member a number nobody gave out reads as.

val.description: Its number, the wire's and fixed: `major << 8 | minor` where the table names majors. One number space holds every protocol's commands: majors 0x00 to 0x0F are xpute's own, and a program's protocol gives none of them nor a number another of its protocols gives.

pkt.description: Its packet's fields, in order; none, no packet.

call.description: The sender waits for the answer: an `export` the host calls, an `import` the host answers before the guest goes on.

ackreq.description: An `import` posted with ACKREQ, its tag the guest's: the host completes it on a later turn with a frame of the same tag and command flagged RES on the submission ring, its result and `reply`'s packet.

reply.description: An `ackreq` import's completion's packet, its fields in order.

type.description: u8, u32, i32, f64, bool, str, or an enum, extern or record named here.
